Package ch.ahdis.matchbox.config

Class MatchboxMetricsConfig

java.lang.Object
ch.ahdis.matchbox.config.MatchboxMetricsConfig
@Configuration @ConditionalOnProperty(prefix="otel.instrumentation.micrometer", name="enabled", havingValue="true") public class MatchboxMetricsConfig extends Object
Configuration for collecting Matchbox metrics and exposing them via Micrometer.
